name: System Time Discovery - PowerShell
description: Identify the system time via PowerShell. Upon execution, the system time will be displayed.

mapping_evidence.note: Execution 7524b555 (Get-Date via PowerShell runspace) MISSED under healthy monitoring. GET /rules?mitre=T1124 returns 0 rules. A detection rule would be a guaranteed false-positive source, so no rule was written (documented coverage gap, not suppressed).
